description: 繁體中文：Nivqo Manager 更新至 1.34.0，基於正式 Morphe Manager 1.34.0 / Morphe Patcher 1.15.1。保留 Nivqo 品牌、app.nivqo.manager、自有更新通道、WorkManager 背景更新、繁中與 Facebook / Messenger 整合。內建 HushFacebook 0.7.1-nivqo.1（60 patches）與 HushMessenger 0.21.0-nivqo.1（33 patches）；Messenger 新增 581 支援，580 / 581 合計 37 個 arm64 builds，核心繁中 213 / 213、Manager metadata 33 / 33。Nivqo Patches 整合來源更新至 0.4.0，共 93 patches。 English: Nivqo Manager 1.34.0 is based on formal Morphe Manager 1.34.0 / Morphe Patcher 1.15.1 while preserving Nivqo branding, package identity, update channels, WorkManager polling, localization and Facebook/Messenger integration. Bundled cores are HushFacebook 0.7.1-nivqo.1 (60 patches) and HushMessenger 0.21.0-nivqo.1 (33 patches), with Messenger 580/581 support across 37 arm64 builds, 213/213 Traditional Chinese core strings and 33/33 localized Manager metadata. Nivqo Patches 0.4.0 contains 93 patches total.
